CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 02 / 12

Price ceilings and floors

Traded quantity under controls管制下交易量

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate quantity demanded, quantity supplied, actual traded quantity, and the resulting shortage or surplus at a controlled price. With ordinary voluntary trading and no government purchase, the short side limits the amount traded.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

把管制價分別代入供需，短缺為 Qd−Qs，過剩為 Qs−Qd。自願交易且政府不額外買賣時，實際交易量取較小數。

Calculate Qd and Qs separately at the controlled price. A shortage is Qd−Qs; a surplus is Qs−Qd. With voluntary trade and no government buying or extra supply, actual trade is limited by the smaller quantity.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：At a floor, Qd=40 and Qs=70. Surplus=30, but only 40 units are sold. 想出售七十不代表售出七十。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

At a ceiling Qd=90 and Qs=60. Quantity sold and shortage? 上限下需九十、供六十？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
